mapper.select: SELECT holding_id AS holdingId, account_id AS accountId, ticker, quantity, average_price AS averagePrice, as_of_date AS asOfDate FROM holding WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND ticker = #{ticker}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holding (account_id, ticker, quantity, average_price, as_of_date) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{ticker}, #{quantity}, #{averagePrice}, #{asOfDate})
mapper.select: SELECT account_id AS accountId, ticker AS symbol, CAST(quantity AS BIGINT) AS quantity, average_price AS averageCost FROM holding WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND quantity > 0 ORDER BY ticker ASC
